en.description:
Experience the joy of chess anywhere with Mini Chess for Watch - a specially designed 6x6 chess game optimized perfectly for your Watch!
Mini Chess adapts the classic game to a compact 6x6 board that fits beautifully on your watch screen while preserving the core strategic elements. The streamlined format offers quicker games without sacrificing the depth and excitement of traditional chess.
Features:
• Compact 6x6 chess board designed specifically for your Watch
• Intelligent AI opponent powered by CoreML
• Player vs Player mode for face-to-face games
• Multiple beautiful board themes (Black & White, Brown, Blue, Green, Red, Dark Oak)
• Optional wooden table background for authentic chess atmosphere
• Save games functionality to continue matches later
• Toggleable sound effects
• Fully offline - no internet connection required
Whether you're waiting for a meeting, commuting, or just have a few minutes to spare, Mini Chess for Watch lets you enjoy the world's greatest strategy game right from your wrist!
en.releaseNotes:
This app has been updated by Apple to prepare for watchOS 27 compatibility. No new features are included.

 Fixed: Settings navigation issue - you can now properly return to the main menu from settings
 Fixed: Game lockup issue caused by infinite AI processing loops

Play face-to-face chess matches with friends
Smooth turn-based gameplay with intuitive interface
Automatic detection of check, checkmate, and stalemate
2. Multiple Board Sizes
Five different chess board layouts: 5×5, 5×6, 6×6, 6×7, and 7×7
Each size features optimized piece arrangements and gameplay
Smaller boards for quick games, larger boards for deeper strategy
4. Interface Improvements
Redesigned board view adapted for all size variants
Enhanced game result screen with clear win/loss display
Streamlined settings menu for easy game customization
